# A customer invoice in the same book as the vendor bills.
#
# GnuCash keeps invoices and bills in one `gncInvoice` type, told apart by
# their owner, so `print-bill` asks every document in the book whether it has
# a vendor. Asked of a customer invoice, `GetOwner().GetVendor()` answers None
# rather than raising — which is why `_all_bills` needs no `except` around it,
# and why that claim has to be made against a book that actually holds one.
#
# A book of bills only never asks the question. This is the ordinary case for
# anyone who both invoices and bills, and it is the shape CLAUDE.md's findings
# about per-distro SWIG accessors say to test rather than reason about.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_cli_print_bill_output.py.
customer "C-PRINT-A"
	name: "Print Customer A"
	currency: CAD
	address_line1: "1 Customer Way"

invoice "INV-BESIDE-001"
	customer_id: "C-PRINT-A"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 500
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-BESIDE-001"
		accumulate: true
